source.source_text: Purpose: stage only explicit authorized paths in one repository; never implicit all-files staging. Input: project_root:string, paths:string[] non-empty. Contract: L2 writes_local; scope mac.git.write; target project_root; timeout 15000ms; cap 256KiB; network none; filesystem write_allowed_project; secret paths denied; approval trusted_write; retry must verify current index state.
